content:
**Nerd Rage!** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The lower the health, the higher the damage multiplier and AP regen multiplier. This is broken up into four linear regimes, based on the player's missing health percentage (for convenience, this page expresses the perk in terms of whole percent, i.e. 50% counts as 50, not .5).

From 0% to 20% missing health, the perk provides negligible benefit (+0% to +1% on both). This then jumps: from 21% to 80% missing, damage climbs linearly from +1% to +40% and ap regen from +1% to +15%. Both then jump in rate again, reaching +80% and +30% by 95% missing health.

| | | Damage Bonus% | Action Points Regen. Bonus% | 
| Remaining % | Missing % | | | 
| 100 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 
| 80 | 20 | 1 | 1 | 
| 20 | 80 | 40 | 15 | 
| 5 | 95 | 80 | 30 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | While your Health is low, gain increased damage and AP regen. | 0004D886 | 

The perk is based on Adrenaline Rush, a perk which had first appeared in *Fallout 2*. The art is also borrowed from Adrenaline Rush, save for a few thematic changes.
